entities.summary: Markus Levonte Wheaton is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon State Beavers and was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the third round of the 2013 NFL draft. He also played for the Chicago Bears and Philadelphia Eagles.
